_comment: P3-B1 (2026-10-06, opt-in): phase2_flex controller (8) + FD structure_v2 (12, P2.5 ranges, from flexbody.gene_schema()) + FD B1 shape block shape_b1 (6, from planform_b1.shape_schema(), L = R, stored in FD's linear [0,1] encoding) = 26 genes. Fidelity full_a1_b1 = FD flexeval_b1.evaluate, called like Evolution Runner's evaluate_genome (ER resolved profile + ER scenarios from shape_b1.er_profile_config, sim = evolution/sim.py, blas 1 thread). Decode: shape -> FD decode_shape_b1 + geometry_gate (fail = status 'geometry_gate:<reason>', cost = FD fail_cost, not flown, never a credit) -> structure genes on the shaped baseline -> margins + flight. struct_v2_source fd (cost = FD + ER sim cost; weights must equal the ER profile's). Init: controller uniform, structure_v2 baseline + N(0, 0.10), then shape = identity planform + clipped Gaussian (sigma 0.25 x half-range in the operator space: ln x for the 3 chord tapers, x for twist/sweep; storage = FD GENE_ENCODING, linear u). Operators (block_ops.py, = ER evolution/ga.py P3-B1): whole-block crossover controller | structure | shape; controller/structure mutation unchanged (evolve.py --mutation-rate/--mutation-sigma); shape mutation = same clipped Gaussian (sigma 0.25 x half-range, operator space), rate = --mutation-rate unless operators.shape.mutation_rate. model_version check vs model_versions_post_p3b1r1.json (FD B1 r1; warn; 'raise' opt-in; superseded r0 strings warn-only). See PHASE3_B1_SPEC.md.
